name: jnbpack
title: Jump 'n Bump's own packer (Brainchild Design, 1998)
_doc: The tool the game ships for building its data file, and the reason it is a target rather than a script: the alternative was to read the format out of pack.c and write the archive here, which is re-implementing a format instead of using the program that owns it. It is also a second program from the same tree passing through PRISM, which costs nothing and checks something.
_host: NOT a DOS program. The packer runs on the developer's machine -- getopt, unistd.h, open/write, and the BSD spelling u_int32_t -- while the game it feeds is DJGPP. Same tree, two platforms, which is ordinary for a tool.
